        "path": "cmd/orchestrator/prompt_bundle.py",
        "line_start": 337,
        "line_end": 355,
        "text": "        # T3.1 (2026-09-28): per-section byte weight of the bundle — the\n        # prompt's named blocks plus context.json's heaviest keys — so the\n        # role-slicing cut is decided on data instead of guesses.\n        bundle_sections: dict[str, int] = {\n            \"prompt.txt\": len(prompt_bytes),\n            \"context.json\": len(context_bytes),\n        }\n        bundle_sections.update(\n            {f\"prompt#/{name}\": size for name, size in _prompt_sections(prompt).items()}\n        )\n        bundle_sections.update(_context_sections(context_value))\n        meter_state = state or str(context_value.get(\"target_state\") or \"\") or phase\n        logger.info(\n            \"PROMPT_BUNDLE_SECTIONS task_id=%s request_id=%s state=%s sections=%s\",\n            task_id,\n            request_id,\n            meter_state,\n            json.dumps(bundle_sections, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),\n        )\n        BUNDLE_METER.record(task_id, meter_state, request_id, bundle_sections)"
      },

        "text": "class MenxiaParallelLimits:\n    # Menxia group pipeline is on by default; NEXUS_MENXIA_ENABLED=0 opts out.\n    enabled: bool = True\n    max_concurrent_groups: int = 1\n    max_concurrent_items: int = 3\n    failure_policy: str = \"continue_and_block_group\""

        "line_end": 436,
        "text": "        fanout_menxia = (\n            node_context.state in MENXIA_ITEM_TARGETS\n            and node_context.dispatch_mode == \"menxia_item_pipeline\"\n            and total > 1\n            and pool_size == 1\n            and child_supported\n        )\n        fanout = (\n            fanout_analyst or fanout_critic or fanout_item_revise or fanout_menxia\n        )\n        if fanout:\n            cap = (\n                total\n                if (fanout_analyst or fanout_item_revise or fanout_menxia)\n                else self._critic_max_workers\n            )\n            max_workers = min(self._node_max_workers, cap, total)"
